    Profile

    Lizardman is a representative of lizardmen, one of the many humanoid species that live on the continent of Babel. They were once a species often exploited by alchemists, but decided that they needed to be more proactive in order to break free from that situation and take control of their own lives. Many are surprised to learn that they are a clever race excelling even at managing public relations.
